title: EvalResult
description: Output schema for codex-eval-executor.sh — constrains codex structured output to a verifiable eval verdict

overall_verdict.description: Aggregate verdict across all evaluated dimensions. 'partial' means some dimensions passed and some failed.

evaluated_dimensions.description: Per-dimension evaluation results. Must include one entry per approved dimension.

verdict.description: Verdict for this dimension based on thresholds and rejection rules

finding.description: Evidence-based summary of what was observed. Must cite concrete evidence, not just a conclusion.

severity.description: Severity of findings: 'blocking' = must fix before shipping, 'warn' = should fix, 'note' = informational

fixtures_tested.description: List of fixture paths or names that were evaluated for this dimension

failures.description: Specific failure instances. Empty array if verdict is 'pass'.

criterion.description: The specific criterion from the threshold or rejection rule that was not met

evidence.description: Concrete evidence of the failure — file path, line number, actual vs expected value, etc.

deviations.description: List of deviations from the spec or contract not captured in dimension verdicts. Empty array if none.

convergence_risk.description: Assessment of repair-loop convergence risk. Null if not applicable. Non-null if patterns suggest the repair path may not converge.
